question.problem:
Given the diagram shown below, what is the value of $x?$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14182164/assets/3fe1e3d1e6f89af1050d0437379a811eabb19212be36f0fecd91ddfaca2594ee.png)
question.worked_solution:
By the segment addition postulate, we have

$$
AD = AB + BC +CD.
$$

To solve for $x,$ we can substitute the given information

$$
AD=30, \quad AB=x+5, \quad BC=13, \quad CD=5x,
$$

 

and then solve the resulting equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}AD & =AB+BC+CD \\ 30 & =(x+5)+13+5x \\ 30 & =6x+18 \\ 6x & =12 \\ x & =2\end{aligned}
$$
